_what: Direction of the GUIDE'S OWN objective (head-predicted FP2 Tanimoto) under steering. This is load-bearing: if guidance does not improve the quantity it optimises, the negative counted-fingerprint result cannot be explained as guide quality.

n64_grid_submitted_point.note: the only place the head-predicted similarity rises; n=64, one seed

conclusion: At scale, and at every held-out (lambda, mu) tried, steering lowers the head-predicted Tanimoto as well as the counted one. The earlier claim that the guide's own similarity improves came from the n=64 grid point and is wrong in general; it has been retracted in docs/provenance/geom/paper_sentences.md. The remaining candidates are the guidance strength/scale (constant mu in place of sigma_t^2/2), the 4-sample log-mean-exp estimator, or an implementation defect -- which `multimfm.geom.diagnostics grad-sign` distinguishes.
